UP-Term kit: parts, licences and where the source is

Every part the kit (UP-Term.lha) ships is listed once. The source column
names the repository (all under ~/Code, pinned together by the upterm
meta-repo, repos.lock) or the archive the source is in. "unconfirmed" means
no licence file or statement for it was found in the tree; the place looked
is named.

Notes
- GNU Unifont is also offered under GPL v2 or later; the kit uses the OFL.
- The Claude and ClaudeCode programs talk to Anthropic's API; AmiSSL 5 (used
  at run time) is not part of the kit.
- Source for the GPL parts is in the kit as source archives where the table
  says so; for GNU screen, tmux, Python and Neovim it is in the repositories
  named, which the upterm meta-repo pins to the commits the kit was built from.
